items.name: El Abra major mill expansion project (Chile)
items.claim: FCX has an opportunity to expand its El Abra operation in Chile with a major mill facility that could add over 700 million pounds of copper production per year; in March 2026 El Abra submitted an environmental impact study to Chile regulatory authorities.
items.source_excerpt: The project could result in the addition of over 700 million pounds of copper production per year. In March 2026, El Abra submitted an environmental impact study to Chile regulatory authorities.

searched.result: Describes Cerro Verde (expansion completed 2015) and El Abra operations; no current dated backlog, RPO, or new named-contract figure beyond the El Abra expansion study already used as the PROJECT item.
Corporate homepage; investor conference and video links only, no quantified backlog/contract/project disclosure.

notes: The stored Q2 2026 8-K exhibit (results release) carries the quantified El Abra expansion project detail used above, plus $4.3 billion of 2026 capital expenditure guidance ($3.0 billion for major mining projects) that is a capex figure, not a named backlog/RPO/contract item, so it was not itemized separately.

changelog.change: run pipeline FREEPORT-MCMORAN (tibet-mega-dam). COMPLETE: 1 PROJECT item (El Abra expansion) from stored 8-K exhibit.
